definition.gate: R60 frozen-criterion dev probe: object-slot byte-length sweep at fixed place 6 B

held_constant.base_fixture: dev[0], as in R59 group B
held_constant.place_name_rule: first word in R59's published GROUP_B_WORDS order; not selected on its reading
held_constant.goal: 让古旧木制器具到旧年石砌场所。
held_constant.template: 2-hop 把{object}放到{place}; records written as {desc}是{name}。 and {desc}对应{name}。

arms.stem_glyph: r58.names_for(1, nbytes)[0] over the same four lengths

sweep.family_shape: each arm is a nested prefix family: only the name byte count changes

measurements.object_edge: position object_stop = 3 + object_bytes; argmax, EOS probability, EOS rank, copy mass
measurements.place_edge: position place_stop = object_stop + 6 + place_bytes; same fields

classifier.pattern: per arm, the four byte_exact booleans in 6/9/12/15 order
branches_in_order: same pattern with a true above a false -> non_monotone_length_effect
classifier.note: branches are mutually exclusive and evaluated in this order; every pattern is reported

main_task_rule.object_min_nine_sufficient: 192/192 may be cited for object >=9 B, limited to these two stems, place 6 B and this description pair
main_task_rule.object_min_twelve_sufficient: 192/192 may be cited for object >=12 B under the same limits
main_task_rule.exact_twelve_only: 192/192 must be cited under the exact trained shape; length variants need retraining
main_task_rule.any_other_class: the capability limit is not relaxed

gates.structural_pass: 12 structural cells exact AND every cell field_lengths_ok
gates.zero_extra_pass: all 8 cells stop at the declared end with zero extra bytes
gates.object_edge_measured: all 8 cells carry a trace at object_stop; missing trace fails closed
gates.anchor_match: the stem_wumu 12 B cell equals R59's published 井前 row on every declared field

anchor.on_mismatch: engineering_failure; the sweep is not interpreted

definition.scope: dev/synthetic only; the sealed confirm split and its holdout report are not read; no change to 192/192
definition.estimate_rule: D-64: single run x 3 (one run plus two replay margins) + report assembly

unit_price_source.r60_single_run_derivation: 5.36 setup+structural + 8 x 0.4854 cells = 9.24; declared 15 with margin

immutability: written once before the run; never rewritten
